actions.reason: C0001 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (25/50 significant, large effect sizes) and stable internal structure (ARI 0.866, PAC 0.230). Although WXS and CNV are not significant after FDR, the RNA signal is coherent and no technical confounders are present. The set is not a simple echo of stage/grade. Accept is supported by the strong RNA evidence and reproducible structure.

C0002 lacks significant biological support across all modalities (no RNA pathways, no WXS/CNV after FDR). Cross-modal consistency is weak (low ARI 0.421, high PAC 0.811) and boundaries to other sets are near zero. No supported split or merge exists, and no extra evidence is available. The evidence is insufficient to retain this set.

C0003 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (31/50 significant) and significant CNV differences (9 features after FDR), providing two distinct support sources. Internal structure is moderately stable (ARI 0.603, PAC 0.529). No technical confounders are significant. The set is not a simple echo of stage/grade. Accept is supported by corroborating RNA and CNV evidence.
